added.summary: Every built-in screen reads its declared props bare ({title}, bind:open={open}), as the built-in components do, so each serves both as a pushed or mounted screen and as an instance (<Confirm title=... />). They read them as $name before; what a screen shows from the same values is unchanged. $toasts and $captions stay: they are the engine's stores, not props. An ejected screen written with $name keeps working.
